title: SlimeVR bone override
description: Overrides selected properties of an existing bone. Definitions are resolved first, then overrides are applied in pack order before the resulting skeleton is validated. `set` merges key by key at the bone's root, at `outputs`, at `outputs.vrchat`, and at `outputs.vrchat.emit` (by address); everywhere deeper it replaces the value wholesale, a `value` pipeline or a `restRotation` list included.

target.description: Key of the bone to override. Overrides cannot rename their target.

set.description: Property values to set on the target bone. `outputs`, `outputs.vrchat`, and `outputs.vrchat.emit` merge per key; everything else, and everything nested deeper than those, is replaced atomically.

remove.description: Property paths to remove. Each path is an array of segments (e.g. ["outputs", "vmc"], or ["outputs", "vrchat", "emit", "/avatar/parameters/ToeLeft1Float"] to remove one message from that bone's emit map). Required identity and display properties cannot be removed.
